title: WoDX Library
description: World of Darkness Expanded: the library. Gear by era: the weapons, armor and cyberware of each era's books, with their pages, from the Dark Ages to Future Darkness, in a compendium and a window that hands them to characters. The shelves: WoDX's own summaries of powers, roads, Arcanoi, conditions, house rules and eras with their pages, a compendium per line, shown by era in the Library window. A manual and a What's new journal every player can read. The Encyclopaedia Tenebrarum: a compendium of lore, characters and rules in plain summaries, every claim with its tier and page. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
